title: corydalis pallida var. chanetii
intro: Corydalis pallida var. chanetii, commonly known as Yellow Corydalis, is a plant species belonging to the family Papaveraceae. It is primarily used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Corydalis pallida var. chanetii include alkaloids like tetrahydroprotoberberine and protopine, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
